title: Machng Chismisan in hot water for mocking Kris Aquino's son
summary: The all-male hosts of the podcast Machng Chismisan are in hot water after they mocked Kris Aquino’s son, Joshua, who is on the autism spectrum, with one host saying latter is “walang kwenta”…

blocks.text: The all-male hosts of the podcast Machng Chismisan are in hot water after they mocked Kris Aquino’s son, Joshua, who is on the autism spectrum, with one host saying latter is “walang kwenta” (useless). Fashion designer Michael Leyva, a close family friend of the Aquinos, is among the first ones to call out the podcast hosts for making fun of Josh. The podcast episode has since been taken down from the group’s page, but clips of it were already reposted by several netizens on social media. “Si Bimby sobrang okay na anak.
